SessionStart.description: Inject METHODOLOGY.md doctrine (decision-sizing triad + reasoning scaffold) into session context
Bridge hook-only ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} into the session as ${KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT} so command markdown (no official ${CLAUDE_COMMAND_DIR}) can reference bundled scripts portably

UserPromptSubmit.description: Advisory: when user prompt looks like non-trivial engineering work, nudge kbg:grilling → kbg:to-prd → kbg:to-issues → /ship

PreToolUse.description: Gate: block irrecoverable Bash patterns (rm -rf, push --force, --no-verify, reset --hard, clean -f)

Gate: ask the human to approve edits to BOTH non-model verifiers — hooks/gates/** + hooks/hooks.json (deny-gates + wiring) AND skills/harness-audit/scripts/audit.sh + checks/** (audit grader). Tamper-resistance: the model cannot edit the code that judges it. Emits permissionDecision: ask (no env-var bypass). Also folds the former path-hardcode deny (blocks hardcoded /Users/<name> in .sh/.py, exit 2 before the ask — block wins) since 2026-07-03; one fewer python3 spawn per Write/Edit.
Gate: ask the human to approve Bash-mediated writes (redirect, tee, sed -i, cp, mv) to verifier surfaces — closes the Write/Edit matcher's blind spot. Emits permissionDecision: ask.

Gate: a subagent may not mark its own task completed (maker≠checker). Only the main session completes tasks; validator subagents return verdicts to main. Denies TaskUpdate(status=completed) when agent_type is present (subagent). Exit 2 + stderr; fail-safe allow on parse error.

Gate: tathep-scoped — redirect Edit/Write on a tathep sub-repo main checkout or protected branch into a session worktree under ~/.worktrees (base branch via TATHEP_BASE, e.g. =main for hotfix). No-op outside the tathep workspace. Moved from dotfiles 2026-07-02. Bash early-exit (2026-07-03): when CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is known and outside the tathep workspace, skip the python3 cold-start entirely and exit 0 — this gate is a no-op there anyway; only the tathep path spawns python.

hooks.command: bash -c 'w="${TATHEP_WORKSPACE:-$HOME/Codes/Works/tathep}"; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [[ -n "$p" && "$p" != "$w" && "$p" != "$w/"* ]]; then exit 0; fi; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gates/worktree-guard.py"'

Stop.description: Stop: track cumulative token and cost metrics per session; appends to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/costs.jsonl

SessionEnd.description: Advisory: remind the operator that kbg:learn exists when the session had enough activity (transcript user-turn count) to plausibly contain a durable learning. Never blocks — SessionEnd has no decision control. Emits to stderr (SessionEnd stdout is discarded; stderr is shown to the user).

WorktreeCreate.description: Gate: enforce kbg single-branch doctrine — deny WorktreeCreate when /.kbg-no-worktree sentinel is present AND a new non-develop branch is being created. Allow detached review-pr worktrees, develop worktrees, and existing-branch worktrees. No-op in repos without the sentinel. Exit 2 + stderr; fail-safe allow on parse / resolution error.

WorktreeRemove.description: Gate: symmetric observer — WorktreeRemove has no decision control per CC docs, but wiring it lets future audit checks verify both events are registered. The script body is a no-op allow on this event.
